MGT 409 · FINAL PROJECT

ENCORE

An AI payment desk that finds the lesson payments students forgot to send, and drafts the reminder the owner keeps forgetting to write.

Denys Drozdyuk · built and tested at DNA Dance Academy

Repo (public): github.com/Drozdyuk1985/encore-dance-payments

The problem: Zelle money with no memory

  • Students pay $160 privates and $70 group classes by Zelle, after class, when they remember
  • The bank shows a name and an amount, with no link to the lesson. It's often a spouse, a parent or a company paying
  • The "system" is the owner's memory at 11 pm, after teaching all day

What's new

Studio software
Jackrabbit, Mindbody, Akada, Pike13

Great reminders, but only if every payment moves onto their system.
Invoicing / Zelle requests
Square, QuickBooks, Zelle request

An invoice per $70 class, or manual one-by-one requests.
ChatGPT
general chatbot

Writes nice texts, but doesn't know who owes, may invent amounts, and you'd paste your whole bank statement.
Encore reads the Chase export as is, keeps only incoming Zelle, learns each payer's rhythm, computes balances in code, and lets AI do only judgment and language. Private by design: the AI sees IDs, not names.

Three agents, one human checkpoint

Radar → Collector → code checks → owner taps Text. Reply handler uses read-only tools; no tool can mark anyone paid. All on gpt-6-luna.

Demo: who owes, then ready-to-send texts

Sample studio (fictional data). The Radar catches the weekly payer silent for 27 days; the Collector writes 6 texts (one in Ukrainian), and all 6 passed the code checks.

Safety: it checks, and can't be talked into paying you

  • Injection: code pre-screen (0 tokens) → untrusted wrapper → provider filter → no "mark paid" tool
  • Invented facts: amounts only from code; typed $ in drafts are rejected
  • Wrong action: nothing sent without the owner; no threats; tone escalates slowly
  • Privacy: non-Zelle rows dropped; AI sees C007, not names
  • Overspend: 400k tokens/day, 6 tool steps, 20 calls/min

The pre-filter cut cost by 12% and time by 27% with the same reminder list in 6 of 6 runs. Found and bypassed Portkey's response cache to measure honestly. Prices: Lecture 11.

Impact: tested on my real studio

  • Real Chase export imported as is; only Zelle kept, on my computer only
  • Radar sorted the full history in one call, $0.0028
  • Honest miss: 3 "maybe forgot" flags, and all 3 had actually stopped coming (0/3)
  • Lesson: silence ≠ debt. The ledger makes "owes" a fact, and the human check makes a wrong guess harmless
  • Shipped the fix: one-tap "Stopped coming"
